name: White Chocolate Raspberry / Banoffee Cream Pie
whyItWorks: Smooth banana-toffee cream pie in a graham/shortbread crust is completely seedless (unlike whole-berry tarts).
prepOrOrderInstructions: Enjoy the banana and caramel cream layers with a Lactaid enzyme; scrape off any seedy raspberry coulis dots on the plate.
watchOuts: Heavy whipped cream and dulce de leche dairy
Raspberry seeds if plated with berry coulis
